initial_candidates.title: Large manual adjustment -6.25M EUR on MOCK_PTF_ATLAS (2025-12-30) flagged as outlier
initial_candidates.claim: Adjustment 96600008 on MOCK_PTF_ATLAS has amount_eur -6,250,000 with z-score -3.28, the largest adjustment in the period. It is part of a month-end concentration (4 adjustments in Dec-2025, 100% period-end share). The adjustment is manual (SOURCE=MANUAL, NATURE='M - Manual') and dated 2025-12-30. Its size and timing warrant review, but no evidence of misconduct or smoothing is present.
analysis_performed: Identified large adjustment via z-score screen.
Checked period-end concentration for Dec-2025.
Reviewed adjustment nature and source fields.
alternative_explanations: May be a legitimate year-end accrual or valuation adjustment.
Could be offset by other adjustments or PnL components not visible in this screen.

counter_evidence.quote: Example of routine month-end accrual true-up adjustment.

initial_candidates.recommendation: Review adjustment 96600008 with desk to confirm business rationale and ensure proper approval.

initial_candidates.title: Period-end adjustment concentration in Dec-2025, Mar-2026, Jun-2026 (100% of adjustments at month-end)
initial_candidates.claim: In Dec-2025, Mar-2026, and Jun-2026, all adjustments (4, 3, and 4 respectively) occur on period-end dates, with period_end_share=1.0. This pattern is consistent with routine month-end accruals and true-ups, but the high concentration at fiscal year-end (Dec and Jun) may warrant additional scrutiny.
analysis_performed: Aggregated adjustments by month and computed period-end share.
Identified months with 100% period-end concentration.
alternative_explanations: Month-end accruals are commonly booked on the last business day.
Year-end periods may have more true-ups due to financial close.

counter_evidence.quote: Adjustment in Aug-2025 not at period-end, showing mixed timing.

initial_candidates.recommendation: No immediate action; monitor if pattern persists with unexplained large amounts.

initial_candidates.title: GOP population mismatch: MOCK_GOP_ECHO in PnL but not in validation history
initial_candidates.claim: MOCK_GOP_ECHO appears in the PnL file (row 6) but has no validation history records. This means the GOP's PnL is not covered by the validation workflow, potentially indicating a gap in validation coverage. The mismatch is one-directional; no validation GOP lacks PnL rows except MOCK_GOP_MIKE (which may be out of scope).

evidence.quote: gop: MOCK_GOP_MIKE (validation GOP without PnL rows)

analysis_performed: Compared GOP populations between PnL and validation files.
Identified GOPs present in one but not the other.
alternative_explanations: MOCK_GOP_ECHO may be a new or decommissioned GOP not yet in validation scope.
Validation history may use a different naming convention or be filtered by pnlType.

counter_evidence.quote: Validation records exist for MOCK_GOP_ALPHA, showing typical coverage.

initial_candidates.recommendation: Confirm with operations why MOCK_GOP_ECHO lacks validation history and ensure all active GOPs are covered.

initial_candidates.title: Monetary reconciliation between PnL and adjustments unresolved due to missing units/inclusion basis
initial_candidates.claim: The deterministic analysis could not reconcile adjustment amounts (AMOUNTINEUR) to PnL DTD because the file headers do not declare units (e.g., EUR vs thousands), sign convention, or whether PnL is pre- or post-adjustment. This is a known limitation; without source documentation, any monetary comparison is unsupported.

Identified missing unit and inclusion documentation.
alternative_explanations: Adjustments may be included in PnL already.
Units may be in millions or thousands.

initial_candidates.recommendation: Obtain documentation on PnL units and adjustment inclusion basis to enable reconciliation.
